I read the full log. Here is the summary.

**Result:** 700 tests ran. 698 passed. 2 failed.

**Failed tests:**

1. `refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token` — `auth/tokens.test.js:400`
2. `sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback` — `auth/tokens.test.js:650`

Both failures are in the same file, `auth/tokens.test.js`, and both point to auth/token-handling bugs: one lets a revoked token pass as valid, the other leaves orphaned rows after a rollback during session cleanup. Everything else in the run passed.
